list.name: household
list.label: 가구
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT household_id FROM reporting.v_report_index ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT household_id FROM reporting.v_report_index ORDER BY 1

list.name: mode
list.label: 평가 출처
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT assessment_mode FROM reporting.v_report_index WHERE household_id=${household:sqlstring} ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT assessment_mode FROM reporting.v_report_index WHERE household_id=${household:sqlstring} ORDER BY 1

list.name: report_id
list.label: 보고일 · 버전
list.query: SELECT period_end::text || ' · ' || to_char(generated_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul','MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' · ' || left(report_id,8) AS __text, report_id AS __value FROM reporting.v_report_index WHERE household_id=${household:sqlstring} AND assessment_mode=${mode:sqlstring} ORDER BY period_end DESC, generated_at DESC, report_id DESC
list.definition: SELECT period_end::text || ' · ' || to_char(generated_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul','MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' · ' || left(report_id,8) AS __text, report_id AS __value FROM reporting.v_report_index WHERE household_id=${household:sqlstring} AND assessment_mode=${mode:sqlstring} ORDER BY period_end DESC, generated_at DESC, report_id DESC

panels.title: 보고서 기준일 · 출처 · 생성 버전 (새 보고서는 새로고침 후 선택)

targets.rawSql: SELECT period_end::text AS 보고일, assessment_mode AS 평가출처, generated_at AS 생성시각, ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date - period_end) AS 보고일경과일수, completeness_scope AS 수집범위, gold_run_id, rule_version, report_id FROM reporting.v_report_index WHERE report_id=${report_id:sqlstring} AND household_id=${household:sqlstring}
SELECT statement AS 요약 FROM reporting.v_report_summary WHERE report_id=${report_id:sqlstring} AND household_id=${household:sqlstring}

panels.title: 일별 기록된 최대 점수 · 누락일은 빈 값

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN extract(isodow FROM usage_date) = 1 THEN to_char(usage_date, 'MM-DD') ELSE repeat(' ', extract(isodow FROM usage_date)::int) END AS date, max_valid_score AS "VALID 최대점수", max_partial_score AS "PARTIAL 최대점수" FROM reporting.v_household_daily WHERE report_id=${report_id:sqlstring} AND household_id=${household:sqlstring} ORDER BY usage_date

panels.title: 일별 평가 건수 · 지속시간 비율 아님

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN extract(isodow FROM usage_date) = 1 THEN to_char(usage_date, 'MM-DD') ELSE repeat(' ', extract(isodow FROM usage_date)::int) END AS date, recorded_count AS "저장 평가건수", valid_count AS "VALID 건수", partial_count AS "PARTIAL 건수" FROM reporting.v_household_daily WHERE report_id=${report_id:sqlstring} AND household_id=${household:sqlstring} ORDER BY usage_date

SELECT appliance_type AS 가전, usage_status AS 상태, usage_minutes AS 사용분, usage_count AS 시작횟수, baseline_eligible AS 유효표본 FROM reporting.v_appliance_daily WHERE report_id=${report_id:sqlstring} AND household_id=${household:sqlstring} AND usage_date=(SELECT period_end FROM reporting.report_runs WHERE report_id=${report_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY appliance_type

SELECT appliance_type AS 가전, statement AS 설명, quality_status AS 품질, values_json AS 계산근거 FROM reporting.v_report_evidence WHERE report_id=${report_id:sqlstring} AND household_id=${household:sqlstring} AND evidence_type='USAGE_FREQUENCY' ORDER BY appliance_type

SELECT statement AS 설명, quality_status AS 품질, values_json AS 평가근거 FROM reporting.v_report_evidence WHERE report_id=${report_id:sqlstring} AND household_id=${household:sqlstring} AND evidence_type='RECORDED_ASSESSMENT' ORDER BY (values_json::jsonb->>'assessed_at') DESC LIMIT 100
